title: Vietnamese-Style Steamed Fish
description: Delicate and flavorful fish steamed to perfection with aromatic Vietnamese spices. Serve with steamed vegetables and a side of rice or noodles.
instructions: 1. Cut the fish fillets into 4 equal pieces and pat dry with paper towels.
2. In a small bowl, mix together ginger, lemongrass, fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and chili flakes.
3. Place a piece of fish in a steamer basket and brush with the ginger-lemon mixture.
4. Repeat with the remaining fish pieces.
5. Steam the fish for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
6. Serve the fish with steamed vegetables and a side of white rice or noodles.
7. Garnish with chopped lemongrass and serve immediately.
